payload.title: Why create_graph=True?
payload.body: The loss needs gradients of u_t and u_x too. create_graph keeps their graph, so backward() can train through the residual.

payload.title: Why does the loss go flat?
payload.body: At β = 30 the residual is easiest to satisfy with a flat u. The net gets stuck there. Start at a small β and raise it step by step.
